notes.title: UPDATE DEMO 25/07/2025
notes.notes:
-Updated game physics so that Timmy jumps to standard height even if he is standing on a descending platform.

-Updated key and controller settings.

-Added full screen/windowed mode.

-You can now hit Crabby to “motivate” him to run faster.

-The end of the Schnecker level has been reworked.



There you go, it took me a while, but it was worth it :)
